name: Bookyourdata
summary: B2B email lists and verified contact data on demand. Build targeted prospect lists with verified business emails and pay only for the contacts you need.
best_for: sporadic, project-based prospecting where a subscription would idle — buy exactly the verified contacts you need, when you need them
skip_if: you prospect continuously at volume (subscription databases price better), or your market is EU-consumer-adjacent where purchased-list outreach gets legally delicate
honest_knock: The model is honest — no subscription, credits keep, bad data refunded — so the real scrutiny belongs on usage. Bought lists are only as good as your targeting and your sending infrastructure, and cold-emailing purchased contacts has legal boundaries that vary by country, GDPR territory especially. The data being accurate doesn't make the campaign compliant; that part is yours.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-13 and again unchanged on 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-06, read on their own pricing page) Pay-as-you-go, no subscription: one credit is one full contact. The published pack table runs 250 credits for $99 ($0.40 each), 500 for $159, 1,000 for $299 ($0.30), 2,500 for $599 and 5,000 for $799 ($0.16). From there it goes 10,000 for $999 ($0.10), 25,000 for $2,099 ($0.08), 50,000 for $3,699 ($0.07), 100,000 for $5,499 ($0.05) and on up to 2,500,000 for $24,999 ($0.010), with anything larger quoted. New accounts get a Free Pack of 10 credits once, with no card. Credits never expire and the 97% deliverability guarantee refunds credits, not money. BeSpoke, the hand-built private list service, is priced separately from $499 for 1,000 records.
